title: Keys Under the Floorboard
description:
The API key was pasted into a Pod spec “just for today.” Security found it.

Move credentials into a **Secret** and inject them the way the brief asks (env and/or file). Plaintext literals left in the Pod template are an automatic fail.

**Meant for:** Secrets.

problemStatement.brief: Create a Secret and inject credentials via env and/or file — plaintext literals in the pod spec fail.
